name: Student / Intern-Trainee Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires enrollment to follow a study programme in Aruba.
Requires a placement for a study internship, traineeship, or work-experience programme in Aruba.

evidence_required.document: Institution acceptance letter or internship/traineeship placement letter

outcome.duration_length: temporary, tied to length of study/placement, annually reviewed

sources.title: DIMAS (Department for the Integration, Management and Admission of Foreign Nationals), Government of Aruba -- Student permit: temporary residence permit to study, no paid work permitted
DIMAS -- Living overview page: intern/trainee permit for study internships, traineeships, or gaining work experience, distinguished from the enrolled-student ground

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Aruba's initial build. Both grounds explicitly prohibit paid employment -- only unpaid trainee-type work experience integral to the study programme is allowed, consistent with how student permits are modelled elsewhere in this dataset. No numeric duration, fee, or minimum-funds figures were found on either DIMAS page in this pass -- flagged as a gap; DIMAS's downloadable application form and sponsorship-statement documents were referenced but not independently reviewed for further detail.
